6329.title: Pi assistant stream completion
6329.rootCauseOneLine: Assistant message boundaries are ignored, so opening a tool detaches unfinished text and agent end completes only the last reply.
6329.proposedFix: Close assistant streams at message end without duplicating the final reply; reconcile the nine recorded parity failures before shipping.
6329.caveats: Deterministic production translator/assembler replay. Candidate fix stopped because nine existing parity tests fail; no PR. Authenticated Pi and browser journeys not run. Reproduction script and output are inline.
